skills.name: Benevolent Light
skills.description: This is a powerful support Skill that reduces CDs, which is one of Credenza's signature features, so it should be a top priority for your team. It also has an NRG Recovery effect, so use it in combination with characters that have high NRG consumption or characters whose main skills have a long CD.
